description:
Aegis Vault Safe is a secure photo and file organizer for iPhone. Import photos, videos, IDs, contracts, screenshots, links, and important documents, then keep them protected in a private space unlocked with device security and your own gesture.

Key features:
• Protect photos, videos, and files on this device
• Import from Photos, Camera, Files, and share extensions
• Organize content with albums, recent imports, and trash recovery
• Optional iCloud encrypted sync for device changes and recovery
• Discreet file-cabinet entry and realistic decoy space
• Pro unlocks unlimited storage, batch organization, advanced disguise, decoy passcodes, intrusion records, and advanced recovery

Your private content stays protected. When iCloud sync is enabled, synced content is encrypted before upload and the developer does not hold your decryption key.
